lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits, with coordinates clustered along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible grid-like nodal pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient, extending from the gill region toward the dorsal fin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of faint, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the leading edge of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular serrated notches along the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; white linear marking on the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Commensal organisms (Echeneidae) observed attached to the trailing edge of the left pectoral fin and positioned near the ventral pelvic region.
